# EvInputWithLabel

> A single-line text input with an inline label placed to the left, right, or both sides of the field. It supports icons, validation, and the same interaction states as InputField.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:input-with-label` |
| Layer | Atom (`src/atoms`) |
| Import | `import { EvInputWithLabel } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvInputWithLabel>` or `<ev-input-with-label>` |
| Source | `src/atoms/input-with-label/EvInputWithLabel.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the inner `<input class="ev-input-with-label__control">`, not the root |

## Example

```vue
<EvInputWithLabel
  placeholder="domain-anda"
  prefix-label="https://"
/>
```

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Input**, frame `4680:3998` (Input With Label). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Use when the label must sit inline with the field to save vertical space.
- Use L Label for a leading label (e.g. "Name:").
- Use R Label for a trailing label or unit-like suffix.
- Use L R Label when both a leading label and trailing element are needed.
- Use validation text to guide correction inline.

### When not to use

- Don't use when the label is long  →  use a stacked InputField (`evoq-ui:input`) with a top label.
- Don't use for choosing from a fixed set  →  use InputDropdown.
- Don't use for dates/times  →  use InputDate / InputTime.
- Don't rely on the placeholder as the label.

### Do

- Keep inline labels short (one or two words).
- Align label and field baselines.
- Show validation text close to the field, on error.
- Use a consistent 16px icon size.

### Don't

- Use long sentences as an inline label.
- Use red borders without an explanatory message.
- Mix label positions inconsistently across a form.
- Disable a field without making the reason clear.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvInputWithLabel`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the inner `<input class="ev-input-with-label__control">`, not the root.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:input-with-label` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
